rows.title: Damage to computer resource / computer related offences
rows.gist: Penalizes unauthorized access, downloading, extraction of data, virus introduction, or denial of service.
rows.plain: Hacking and data offences sit under the IT Act alongside BNS cheating. Requires digital forensics hash matching and raw image preservation.
rows.in_game: Cyber branch charging: BNS s.318 plus IT Act sections for the intrusion itself. Requires BSA s.63 electronic certificate.

rows.title: Identity theft and cheating by personation using computer resource
rows.gist: Punishes fraudulent use of electronic signature, password, or unique identification feature, and cheating by personation.
rows.plain: Covers credential harvesting, SIM swap attacks, phishing, and spoofed caller IDs.
rows.in_game: Applies to telecom/CDR trace leads and forged credentials seized in electronic storage.

rows.title: Duty of driver in case of accident and punishment for omission
rows.gist: Mandates taking injured persons to hospital, reporting accident to police station within 24 hours.
rows.plain: Road accident reporting and vehicle tracing duties.
rows.in_game: Roadside scene branch: chassis/engine number and ANPR tracing feed vehicle identity proof.

rows.title: Prohibition and punishment for contravention involving manufactured drugs
rows.chapter: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
rows.gist: Prohibits cultivating, producing, manufacturing, possessing, selling, purchasing, transporting or storing narcotics.
rows.plain: The narcotics law, separate from the BNS. Quantity seized decides the severity band.
rows.in_game: Tier 5 branch. The quantity recovered (a lab-weighed fact) sets the punishment band, so the seizure and weighing protocol must be perfect.

rows.title: Possession and use of unlicensed prohibited arms or ammunition
rows.gist: Prohibits acquisition, possession, manufacture, or carriage of firearms and ammunition without license.
rows.plain: Illegal possession of country-made pistols, modified barrels, or ammunition recovered during searches.
rows.in_game: Ballistics lab match triggers Arms Act charge addition alongside BNS s.103/109 (murder/attempt).

rows.title: Sexual assault against children and punishment
rows.chapter: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
rows.gist: Defines sexual assault with physical contact on a child under 18 years of age.
rows.plain: Special protective statute overriding general penal code with child-friendly recording protocols.
rows.in_game: Mandates woman officer in civil clothes, recording under camera, and zero police lockup detention for minors.

rows.title: Mandatory reporting of offences and penalty for failure
rows.chapter: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
rows.gist: Creates affirmative duty on any person or medical/hospital staff to report knowledge of child sexual offence.
rows.plain: Strict legal liability for institutions, medical staff, and witnesses who fail to report.
rows.in_game: Can be charged against evasive institutional witnesses and hostel wardens.

rows.title: Bribery and criminal misconduct by public servant
rows.gist: Penalizes public servants obtaining undue advantage and intentional illicit enrichment.
rows.plain: Applies to corrupt state officials, extortion under official cover, and illicit asset accumulation.
rows.in_game: Anti-corruption trap cases require phenolphthalein powder test verification and prior sanction.

rows.title: Terrorist acts, conspiracy, and funding operations
rows.gist: Defines acts threatening unity, integrity, security or sovereignty of India using bombs, firearms, or lethal substances.
rows.plain: High-priority national security statute allowing extended remand and special fast-track courts.
rows.in_game: National security desk escalation: requires Special Cell coordination and 180-day charge sheet horizon.

rows.title: Offence of money-laundering and attachment of proceeds of crime
rows.gist: Whosoever directly or indirectly attempts to indulge or knowingly assists in projecting untainted property.
rows.plain: Used to seize bank accounts, shell company transfers, and real estate derived from predicate offences.
rows.in_game: Financial ledger forensic analysis enables bank account attachment orders.

rows.title: Penalty for giving, taking, or demanding dowry
rows.gist: Penalizes any person giving, taking or abetting the giving or taking of dowry.
rows.plain: Allied charge accompanying matrimonial offences and suspicious death of married women within 7 years.
rows.in_game: Linked with BNS s.80/85 (dowry death / cruelty by husband or relatives).

rows.title: Causing explosion likely to endanger life or property
rows.gist: Punishes maliciously causing explosion of a nature likely to endanger life or cause serious injury.
rows.plain: Regulates improvised explosive devices (IEDs), detonators, and industrial blasting materials.
rows.in_game: Forensic lab explosive residue chemical testing unlocks Explosive Substances Act sections.
